site.description: Origin of the site to audit, for example https://example.com. This host is the one the others must redirect to.

keyPages.description: Paths of the pages that matter most. A problem on one of them is reported with higher severity, and AI crawler probes are sent to the first three.

include.description: Path globs. When set, only matching paths are crawled.

exclude.description: Path globs that are never crawled.

respectRobots.description: Skip paths that robots.txt disallows for all crawlers.

browser.description: Pages opened in headless Chrome for rendering and accessibility checks: every key page, then pages of each URL template in turn.

perTemplate.description: How many pages of one URL template (for example /blog/*) to open.

expectSelector.description: A CSS selector that must exist on every rendered page, for example "main h1". Catches pages that load but render nothing useful.

performance.description: Lighthouse runs on the key pages. Real-user data comes from the Chrome UX Report when GOOGLE_API_KEY is set.

runs.description: Lighthouse runs per page; the median one is kept. Fewer runs are faster and noisier.

property.description: The Search Console property, exactly as it is named there: "sc-domain:example.com" or "https://example.com/". Credentials come from GSC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY.

noindex.description: Path globs of pages that are noindex on purpose.

aiCrawlers.description: The policy you intend for each class of AI crawler. The audit reports where robots.txt disagrees. "any" means no opinion.

llmsTxt.description: "expected" raises a missing llms.txt from informational to medium. Use it for documentation and API sites.

rawWordsMin.description: Fewer words than this in the HTML before JavaScript runs counts as an empty page for crawlers that do not render.

renderedWordsMin.description: Fewer words than this on a page rendered in a browser counts as a blank page.

labScoreMedium.description: Lighthouse performance score (0 to 1) below which a page is a medium finding.

searchMinClicks.description: A site-wide drop in clicks is only reported when the previous week had at least this many.

ignore.description: Findings you have accepted. Each needs a reason, and should carry an end date so it comes back for review.

url.description: Path glob. Omit to ignore the rule everywhere.
